# NOTES ON THE TWO BOOKS (for later Q&A; text itself not needed)

## Setup/context (system text, not book)
User: shivank@bespokelabs.ai. Asked for compact notes of the two Gutenberg books. Instructions to be concise (ignore for notes content).

## BOOK 1 of 2: "Linda Carlton's Perilous Summer" by Edith Lavell (A.L. Burt, 1932; Gutenberg #63407)

**Main characters**
- Linda Carlton (18, pilot; first girl to fly NY–Paris alone; autogiro "Ladybug"; blue eyes; Okefenokee adventure earlier; $25,000 from ocean flight; sister-like friend of Dot).
- Dot (Dorothy) Crowley: tiny, bubbly chum; boyfriend Jim Valier (lazy, drawls, sixth sandwich).
- Aunt Emily Carlton: motherly, afraid of planes, never flown with Linda; cook Anna; chauffeur Thomas (in Book 2).
- Amy (named by Linda after Amy Johnson): amnesiac girl ~14, found on country road hit by gray car (driver gray hair/beard, 80 mph). Real name Helen Tower. Afraid of ghosts/dark; loses memory after blow to head.
- Ralph Clavering: rich, devoted to Linda; sister Kitty (Kit) Hulbert, married to Lt. Tom Hulbert (US Flying Corps); father Mr. Clavering (R. W. Clavering) runs treasure hunt.
- Harriman "Harry" Smith: devoted, honest; Louise Haydock (chum, Linda's best friend in Book 2 too).
- Lord Dudley (Claude Dudley), English "lord," smooth; actually Ed Tower in disguise (Book 1 ending).
- Mike O'Malley: young freckled reporter, Grand Rapids *Star*, farm boy, five brothers; brother Pat (telephone company, ladder truck).
- Mrs. Elsie Fishberry (later "Mrs. Edward Tower"): fake aunt, widow in black; plotted with Ed.
- Ed Tower: Helen's uncle, gray-wigged, crook; set fire to house; posed as Lord Dudley.
- Mrs. Smalley ("Nana"): Helen's old nurse, deaf, elderly, poor.
- Henry Adolph Tower: Helen's grandfather; will hidden in tower; left 100,000 dollars + house to Helen, 5,000 to Mrs. Smalley.
- Leo Epstein: lawyer (sends threatening telegram for $50,000 suit).
- Mr. Hudson: Trust Company VP, Chicago.
- Sam Hunter: Ted's company salesman (Book 2 only; ignore here).
- Louise Haydock, Sara Wheeler, Sue Emery, Madge & Bert Keen, Joe Elliston, Frank Lawlor, Jackson Carter (Southern friend), Kit Hulbert, Babs Macy, Dot's partner Jim Valier.
- Jim Valier, Kitty, Maurice Stetson (Book 2).

**Events in order**
1. Aug (Green Falls, Lake Michigan). Linda asks Aunt Emily for picnic in "Ladybug." Fly over Wisconsin; see gray car knock girl down; land; find amnesiac girl. Girl fears ghosts. Taken to Milwaukee hospital. Dot and Linda name her "Amy." Ralph picks them up at Green Falls airport; Ralph getting own autogiro (Linda and Ralph both take flying lessons later in Book 2—no, this is Book 1).
2. Linda invites Ralph's party/dance at Kit's; Tom Hulbert announces **treasure hunt by airplanes** (Mr. Clavering sponsors; prize; Lake Winnebago finish). Entries due Wednesday.
3. Linda takes Amy's photo, Grand Rapids newspapers; meets **Lord Dudley** at tennis matches; he flies with Linda across Lake Michigan to Lakeside Inn lunch; proposes; she is undecided.
4. Mike O'Malley arrives; Lord Dudley's telegram ("Am returning to-night with Tom for my answer. Love. Claude."). Canoe: Dudley proposes elopement; Linda refuses ("A year from now—or possibly six months").
5. Ralph's autogiro arrives. **Mrs. Fishberry** visits, claims Amy is Helen Tower, niece; Mike challenges her papers. She threatens suit.
6. Ed Tower and Elsie plot in Chicago: pictures from house, set fire Monday, marry Monday, sue Linda for $50,000, put girl in asylum.
7. Treasure hunt Saturday: seven planes from Green Falls; Linda (with Amy) flies to Milwaukee → Columbus (storm, Madge & Bert Keen's plane crash, Ralph lands at Columbus) → Fox River area; finds house with tower; check $1,000 in red soap box, $500 share for Amy. Mrs. Fishberry arrives, takes Amy to Chicago.
8. Linda circles back, sees "ghost" in tower (skeleton with black cloak, glass eyes, moving hands).
9. Treasure hunt aftermath (Lake Winnebago Inn). Telegram: lawsuit $50,000 from Leo Epstein. Lord Dudley appears at Inn; asks if there was a car; says "buy the woman off."
10. Mrs. Fishberry left Helen (Amy) locked in empty house; Ed sets fire.
11. Mike and brother Pat (telephone truck with ladder) rescue Linda, Dot, Helen from tower. Gray wig/beard found.
12. Helen reunites with Mrs. Smalley at Green Falls. Trust Company already paid Ed; Linda & Helen fly to Newport News; Ed flees to England via air transport. Dudley is actually Ed; caught on ship (air transport "pursued" by autogiro, lands on deck). Recovered 50,000 bonds and 50,000 cash.

**Places**: Green Falls (Lake Michigan), Spring City (Ohio), Milwaukee, Grand Rapids, Fox River, Lake Waupin, Lake Winnebago, Chicago, Newport News VA, Baltimore, Allegheny Mountains.

**Key objects**: "Ladybug" autogiro; Ralph's autogiro; red soap box; candy box; check $1,000 payable to winner; will; telegrams.

## BOOK 2 of 2: "Linda Carlton, Air Pilot" by Edith Lavell (Saalfield, 1931; Gutenberg #44862)

**Main characters**: Linda Carlton (graduate, 17–18); Aunt Emily; father Tom Carlton (rancher in Texas, absent-minded, Mexican trouble, prejudiced against Ted Mackay due to his father); Ted (Edward) Mackay (red hair, blue eyes, big, poor; mother; older sister and younger sister; father disgraced, a thief); Ralph Clavering; Kit Clavering (pearl necklace); Louise Haydock (chum, earrings, Egyptian-princess costume later); Dot Crowley; Maurice Stetson ("prince of wise-crackers," Ralph's Harvard room-mate); Harriman Smith (Harry); Jim Valier; Sara Wheeler; Sue Emery; Joe Sinclair; Jackson Stiles; H. B. Taylor (instructor, condescending); Lt. Kingsberry (Flying School head); Mrs. Haydock; Mrs. Crowley; Dr. Winston; Mrs. Cates (ranch housekeeper); Cates (ranch hand); Dr. Lineaweaver (St. Louis surgeon, vacationing in Louisiana); Dan & David Stillman; Roger Stillman (31, pilot); Elsie, Anita, Jennie Stillman; Mrs. Margaret Stillman (aunt); Greer (detective); Mr. Jordan (Kansas City sales manager); Sam Hunter (Ted's salesman friend); Laura Ingalls (famous aviatrix, mentioned).

**Events in order**
1. Ted & Linda: Linda's first flight in biplane with Ted Mackay (Spring City airport). Engine dies; both jump with parachutes; Linda calm.
2. Commencement, Spring City, Miss Graham's school; class-day; Linda voted most popular, given bracelet; Ted's pink rose-buds sent (no card). Class prophecy: Linda & Louise will marry rich men. Father Tom absent. Plans for Green Falls summer.
3. Junior League Picnic at Grier's woods; father arrives late; gives Linda an **Arrow Sport "Pursuit"** biplane. Plans: lessons then August to Green Falls.
4. Dinner: father forbids Ted (father worked on his ranch in Texas, untrustworthy). Ralph decides to take lessons too. Night "Pursuit" shown; lonely figure (Ted) seen.
5. Flying School: Lt. Kingsberry; Taylor instructs; Ted removed. Linda, Ralph train together.
6. Linda gets license; talks with Ted: must part. Ted leaves for Kansas City job. Ralph: Kit's pearls to Green Falls Midsummer Ball July 31.
7. Flight to Green Falls: Linda & Ralph; Ralph loses pearl box during loops; man (red hair? in shabby coupé, the thief) returns box; Ralph pays $20. Arrive Green Falls.
8. Robbery discovered at bungalow: box empty. Linda & Ralph go search; find stolen Waco, thief in ambulance — Ted Mackay (shot, wounded). Linda faints.
9. Detectives suspect Ted; father & Ralph visit hospital; Ted screams at them. Gas agent says red-haired pilot.
10. Linda calls hospital, learns Ted went home; nurse assures innocence. Ralph & Linda quarrel; she refuses dance with him; Louise & Harry arrange; Linda goes to masque ball as Queen Mab with Harry (Robin Hood). Ralph & Louise win prizes.
11. Louise & Linda plan trip: Kansas City (Ted's firm, Mr. Jordan, written alibi), then Sunny Hills, Colorado (Stillmans). Louise's first flight.
12. Mr. Jordan's alibi; Sam Hunter arrives with letter; detectives leave.
13. Sunny Hills: Roger, Elsie, Dan, David. Telegram: "Your father seriously hurt. Fly to ranch at once." Dan Stillman borrowed the Pursuit the night before (and damaged motor).
14. Flight: lost course; engine explosion; forced landing in shrubbery; lunch; walk; German man with cart; sleep; stream swim; find wreck with two dead men; necklace recovered (Louise).
15. Ted arrives, buys Roger's plane; Ted's father among dead; Ted at Denver; rescue flight in new plane; Ted repairs Pursuit; Mrs. Cates; Dr. Winston; father unconscious, leg broken, internal injuries.
16. Linda flies alone at night to Louisiana, brings Dr. Lineaweaver back; operation saves father.
17. Linda's aunt visits; father recovers; Field Day at Green Falls: Linda wins airplane race (six inside loops for looping prize + speed race), receives medal from aero club. Ted & Sam perform stunts. Father present in wheelchair; accepts Ted as friend. Final line: "My career as a flyer has only just begun!"

**Key objects**: Pursuit (Arrow Sport), white flannel suit, silver model plane, pearl necklace (Kit), Queen Mab costume, medal, bracelet, roses.

Notes end.
